PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_HiBrothersAt:
DAISY: Hi, {PLAYER}!
My brother, {RIVAL}, is out at Grandpa's LAB.
PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_HeardYouBatt:
DAISY: {PLAYER}, I heard you had a battle against {RIVAL}.
I wish I'd seen that!
PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ErrandForGra:
Grandpa asked you to run an errand?
Gee, that's lazy of him. Here, this will help you.
PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ReceivedTown: {PLAYER} received a TOWN MAP from DAISY.
PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_DontHaveSpac: You don't have space for this in your BAG.
PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ExplainTownM: You can use the TOWN MAP to find out where you are, or check the names of places.
PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_PleaseGiveMo:
DAISY: Just like people, POKéMON are living things.
When they get tired, please give them a rest.
PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ItsBigMapOfK: It's a big map of the KANTO region. Now this would be useful!
PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ShelvesCramm: The shelves are crammed full of books on POKéMON.
PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_LikeMeToGroo:
DAISY: Hi, {PLAYER}! Good timing.
I'm about to have some tea. Would you like to join me?
Oh, but look. Your POKéMON are a little dirty.
Would you like me to groom one?
PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_DontNeedAnyG: You don't need any grooming done? Okay, we'll just have tea.
PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_LookingNiceI: DAISY: Okay, I'll get it looking nice in no time.
PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ThereYouGoAl:
{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{STR_VAR_1} looks dreamily content…
{COLOR RED}DAISY: There you go! All done. {FONT_NORMAL}{STR_VAR_1} looks dreamily content…
{FONT_FEMALE}DAISY: There you go! All done. See? Doesn't it look nice?
Giggle… It's such a cute POKéMON.
PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_CantGroomAnE: Oh, sorry. I honestly can't groom an EGG.
PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_MayISeeFirst:
DAISY: Your POKéMON grow to love you if you raise them with love.
For example, {PLAYER}, may I see your first POKéMON?
PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_CouldntLoveY:
It couldn't possibly love you any more than it does now.
Your POKéMON is happy beyond words.
PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ItLooksVeryH:
It looks very happy.
I wish {RIVAL} could see this and learn something from it.
PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ItsQuiteFrie: It's quite friendly with you. Keep being good to it!
PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ItsWarmingUp: It's warming up to you. Trust must be growing between you.
PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_NotFamiliarW:
It's not quite familiar with you yet.
POKéMON are all quite wary when you first get them.
PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_DontLikeWayI:
{PLAYER}, I don't like the way it glares at you.
Could you try being a little nicer to it?
PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_WhyWouldMonH:
…Um, it's not easy for me to say this, but…
Is there some reason why your POKéMON would hate you so much?
